data.other_hard: completed secondary education outside the UAE; first-time student; enrolls in the fall semester; IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 94; portfolio with essay, three-minute video and two recommendation letters; selection depends heavily on academic excellence
data.evidence_sentence: The President’s Scholarship is open to applicants who have completed their secondary education outside the UAE and covers 100 percent of tuition and lab fees and an application fee waiver.
data.notes: Page lists several scholarships; this describes only the President’s Scholarship. min_gpa 98 percent is the Other Education Systems requirement (98 percent CGPA in grades 10 and 11 and in grade 12); British, IB, American and other curricula use different thresholds (e.g., IB 40 points, A-levels, 98 percent CGPA plus APs or SAT). Nationality is not stated for this award; the only open-to-all wording concerns financial grants, not this scholarship. Applicants must receive an admission offer first. Application link opens December 2026. Monthly stipend, on-campus housing and three round-trip tickets are also included.
